note: Values match spike.gd/spike.tscn literally; see README.md. *_bits are the IEEE-754 float32 hex encoding (little-endian byte order read back as a little-endian u32, i.e. new DataView(new Float32Array([x]).buffer).getUint32(0, true)) of each field in *_bits order. Every value here is an exact sum of negative powers of two, so it round-trips through float32 bit-exact -- this is not a tolerance-budgeted fixture.

script_add_rect.description: spike.gd _draw(): RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_rect(get_canvas_item(), SCRIPT_RECT, SCRIPT_RECT_COLOR) -- antialiased defaults to false (servers/rendering_server.h canvas_item_add_rect).

script_add_polygon.description: spike.gd _draw(): RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_polygon(get_canvas_item(), _polygon_points, _polygon_colors) -- uvs/texture omitted, so uvs_count is 0 (servers/rendering_server.h canvas_item_add_polygon DEFVAL(Vector<Point2>())).

colorrect_add_rect.description: Engine-internal path, not a script call: ColorRect::_notification(NOTIFICATION_DRAW) calls CanvasItem::draw_rect(Rect2(Point2(), get_size()), color) (scene/gui/color_rect.cpp), i.e. the rect is in the ColorRect's OWN local coordinates (0,0,width,height), not its (40,40) scene position -- the position is carried by the node's separate canvas transform, which this capture format does not need to decode for Gate -1. draw_rect's default filled=true/antialiased=false path calls canvas_item_add_rect directly (scene/main/canvas_item.cpp).

label_glyphs.description: Label draws its glyphs through the font's texture-atlas path, captured as canvas_item_add_texture_rect_region (bitmap font atlas) or canvas_item_add_msdf_texture_rect_region (MSDF font atlas) calls -- either counts for Gate -1, which only needs the path exercised, not a specific font backend. Starts as "Spike Ag"; spike.gd changes it to "Spike Ag Qz!" at frame 30, which must introduce new glyphs (Q, z, !) and so a font atlas texture_2d_update after frame 30.

draw_paths.description: Calibrator-2 hooks, exercised by spike.gd/spike.tscn. Entries in counters.json's captured.<hook> are deduplicated (identical calls bump calls/last_frame). 'script' entries are on the scene root's canvas item, the one the scripted canvas_item_add_rect lands on; 'native' entries come from engine-internal draws on another item. Signatures: servers/rendering_server.h of 4.5.1, cited per hook in capture/src/hooks.cpp.

triangle_array.description: spike.gd _draw(): canvas_item_add_triangle_array(item, indices, points, colors, uvs) -- bones/weights empty, texture RID() (0), count -1 by default.

stylebox_panel.description: Native: the Panel's StyleBoxFlat draws through canvas_item_add_triangle_array (scene/resources/style_box_flat.cpp), every vertex colour bg_color, opaque for the fill and at alpha 0 for the anti-aliasing feather ring; spike.gd also sets the Panel's modulate (canvas_item_set_modulate) and a ShaderMaterial (canvas_item_set_material) whose shader is created from code, re-coded (shader_create_from_code, shader_set_code) and given a parameter (material_set_param).

nine_patch_script.description: spike.gd _draw(): canvas_item_add_nine_patch on the 4x4 RGBA8 (format 5) ImageTexture spike.gd creates, whose RID is the texture_2d_create capture of that size. x/y axis modes NINE_PATCH_TILE (1) / NINE_PATCH_TILE_FIT (2); draw_center false and modulate are stack-passed arguments, so they prove the tail of the decode.

nine_patch_native.description: Native: NinePatchRect::_notification(NOTIFICATION_DRAW) (scene/gui/nine_patch_rect.cpp) with the same texture, in its own local rect (0, 0, 100, 60), margins (left, top) / (right, bottom) = (1, 1) / (2, 2), stretch modes, draw_center true, an empty region rect, default modulate.

primitive.description: spike.gd _draw(): canvas_item_add_primitive with 4 points/colours/UVs on the 4x4 texture.

line.description: spike.gd _draw(): canvas_item_add_line(item, from, to, color, 3.5) -- antialiased false by default.

polyline.description: spike.gd _draw(): canvas_item_add_polyline with 3 points, one colour, width 2.5.

set_transform.description: spike.gd _draw(): canvas_item_add_set_transform(item, Transform2D(x=(1,0), y=(0,1), origin=(400.5, 0.25))), written as columns x, y, origin.

circle.description: spike.gd _draw(): canvas_item_add_circle after the add_set_transform, local position (40.5, 250.25), radius 20.75.

mesh.description: spike.gd: an ArrayMesh (ArrayMesh::_create_if_empty -> mesh_create; add_surface_from_arrays -> mesh_add_surface) with 3 Vector2 vertices and colours, flag ARRAY_FLAG_USE_DYNAMIC_UPDATE. format = VERTEX|COLOR|USE_2D_VERTICES|USE_DYNAMIC_UPDATE|FORMAT_VERSION_2 = 1+8+2^25+2^26+2^35; vertex stride 8 (2 floats), attribute stride 4 (RGBA8); aabb is the computed bounds. _draw() adds it with canvas_item_add_mesh and a translation transform, and canvas_item_add_multimesh adds a 1-instance 2D MultiMesh of it.

vertex_region.description: spike.gd _process(), every frame: mesh_surface_update_vertex_region(mesh, 0, 8, PackedFloat32Array([110.25, 330.5]).to_byte_array()) -- vertex 1 moves; the headless-armed leg is armed for 60 frames.

attribute_region.description: spike.gd _process(), every frame: mesh_surface_update_attribute_region(mesh, 0, 8, [255, 255, 0, 255]) -- vertex 2's RGBA8 colour.

custom_aabb.description: spike.gd _process(), every frame: mesh_set_custom_aabb, as spine-godot does after each region update.

visible_samples.description: Pixels of unarmed.png (and so of the byte-identical armed.png) that each new drawing covers: some pixel within 1 px must differ from the clear colour by more than 16 in a channel. moved_mesh_vertex lies inside the drawn mesh only because vertex 1 moved to (110.25, 330.5) (+ the (130.5, 0.25) transform): the original triangle does not reach it.
